summary.en: In Gunma prefecture, Kogoro has just solved a case of a son running away from home due to failing the entrance exam, which was actually thanks to Conan finding a photo posted by the missing person on the Internet. Kogoro decides to find a restaurant there to eat as a way to reward himself, but he is not convinced with the one Conan just picks on the Internet, and decides to call Yamamura to suggest a reliable one, with Ran grumbling that in her mind that they found the person thanks to the internet. However, as soon as Yamamura hears that the great detective is in Gunma, he asks the detective to aid him at a scene of the murder that was assigned to him, because Yamamura also encounters three terrifying Nagano police officers.
